tool_about: geometry-central computes geodesic distances from three cylinder vertices with its heat-method solver. Colors show distances on the unwrapped surface. The original native library is built with Eigen 3.4.0 and its pinned happly submodule. Mean distance error is checked against the exact cylindrical geodesic formula. The map unwraps angle and height for display; colors are normalized per source. The recipe caches checksum-verified archives and the compiled binary, and reruns the heat solve every time.
